title: Canadian Oat Bake
description: A delicious and easy-to-make oat bake perfect for a snack or dessert. Inspired by Canadian flavors.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, mix together oats, honey, and dates until well combined.
3. Add maple syrup and mix until the mixture is sticky and holds together.
4. Grease an 8-inch square baking dish with butter.
5. Press the oat mixture into the prepared baking dish.
6. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until lightly golden brown.
7. Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
8. Cut into bars and serve warm or at room temperature.
